PermitRow.description:
One Permit in the per-user Politeness file (ADR 0053): a request in
flight under one key, such as a domain key, with the Run and run epoch
that hold it, so an engine reclaims the Permits of a Run whose writer
lock is free or held at a later epoch.

engine.description: The engine that took it, which gives it back itself.

epoch.description: The run epoch it was taken under (ADR 0003).

key.description: The key it counts under, such as a domain key.

run_folder.description: The Run's folder, whose writer lock tells whether the Run is live.

taken_at.description: When it was taken, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
